Ogni release nuova passa dai controlli a: Every new release goes through the Platform's automatic security checks (OpenSSF Scorecard score, antivirus, components with known vulnerabilities) before being announced to Installers. A release with a serious problem isn't announced until the Builder fixes it or the Platform verifies it's a false alarm. The checks reduce risks but don't rule them out: [the Platform does not guarantee the absence of vulnerabilities in third-party software].
Per i Clienti che pagano l'assistenza, l: For Customers who pay for support, the Installer answers the requests that come from the bubble, the support page or the customer area [within 24 hours, on working days]. They can bring in the Builder when the problem is in the code; the Builder answers if and when they can. Whoever doesn't answer gets a reminder; after [72 hours] the request goes to the Platform.
Se il Cliente non paga l'assistenza, dop: If the Customer doesn't pay for support, after [7] days of grace the Installer doesn't have to step in until the payment arrives. In no case does the Installer block, disable or alter the installed software, or withhold the Customer's data, credentials or backups to obtain a payment: the software and the data belong to the Customer, and doing so may be a crime (art. 392 of the Italian penal code). Il Cliente paga con carta o addebito SEP: The Customer pays by card or SEPA debit through Stripe, or in crypto as described in point 10.
